deviations.description: Manually removed 6 orphaned deployed files and 4 ghost context/index.json rows, beyond the plan's literal 'run deploy-headless.sh, confirm absent' instruction
deviations.reason: Direct code reading confirmed deploy-headless.sh's non-destructive default is additive-only by design and never prunes a file whose source was deleted (context/patterns/deploy-orphan-detection.md's own 'detect, never auto-delete' section). The plan's own choice of the non-destructive default over --wipe (reasonable, given concurrent siblings on this same tree) was in tension with its adjacent instruction that the deleted files be 'absent' afterward. Resolved using that same pattern document's explicitly sanctioned alternative to --wipe: targeted removal of the specific orphan paths. Confirmed clean via gate 13 immediately after.
